mechanism: Meloxicam may increase haloperidol levels through CYP3A4/CYP2C9 inhibition and NSAIDs can increase CNS effects; both drugs may increase risk of anticholinergic effects and gastrointestinal bleeding.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, anticholinergic effects); consider gastroprotection; use lowest effective doses and consider alternative analgesic if possible.
